comment: The demo's sample Carnet (invented people), shared by the iPhone and Android apps. Agents are demo.json's ids; « you » is the person, « nightly:<agent> » the nightly pass. {date+N}: the day N days after today. Sections: each page's fixed outline (id and title, in the bridge's order: notebook/template.rs); a document of type page opens demo.json's page of that id; « me » is the person's own page (kind self, « Toi »); health_documents are the private health part's.
